system.description:
You conjure a shard of crystal infused with your will that bonds to you in a visible place of your choice. This crystal radiates a 10-foot radius aura, centered on you. The size of this aura increases by +5 feet at 7th and 15th levels.

When creatures within your crystals aura take damage, you can spend your Reaction and up to 2 Hardness per creature damaged to shield them from harm. For each Hardness spent on a creature, remove the highest rolled damage die from the damage total affecting that creatures, working from the highest to lowest value. Increase the number of Hardness you can spend per creature to 4 at 7th level and 6 at 15th level.
